posts.title: The Impermanence Door
posts.description: Buddhism teaches that all compound things are impermanent, and that sickness, old age, and death await us all. There are times when this teaching feels remote and abstract, and times when it feels raw and intimate. posts.title: Two Fingers Pointing to the Moon
posts.description: A complete grasp of non-duality is beyond limited beings such as ourselves.
